entry_points: App launch when not signed in

controls.label: Sign in with Apple
controls.evidence: Sign in with Apple requires real Apple ID/iCloud creds; dev-bypass launch arg exists (--likeminded-dev-auth-bypass, defaults to validation-gurusharan) but app needs GUI session to fire .task. macOS screencapture/AppleScript blocked in this environment.
controls.blocker: Real Apple ID unavailable without TestFlight creds
